skills.name: sumsub-api-auth
skills.description: Authenticate to the Sumsub API with an App Token + secret key (HMAC-SHA256 request signing). Sandbox tokens only.

skills.name: sumsub-create-questionnaire
skills.description: Create or update a Sumsub KYC questionnaire definition. POST /resources/api/agent/questionnaires to create (409 if id exists), PATCH same path to update (404 if id is unknown), GET /resources/api/agent/questionnaires/{id} to read.

skills.name: sumsub-create-poa-preset
skills.description: Create or update a Sumsub PoaStepSettings (Proof-of-Address preset). POST /resources/api/agent/poaStepSettings to create, PATCH same path to update (id in body), GET /resources/api/agent/poaStepSettings/{id} to read. Returned id attaches to a level's PROOF_OF_RESIDENCE doc-set.

skills.name: sumsub-create-level
skills.description: Create or update a Sumsub ApplicantLevel. POST /resources/applicants/-/levels to create, PATCH same path to update (id in body), GET /resources/applicants/-/levels/{id} to read. Compact docSet spec → full payload.

skills.name: sumsub-create-cross-check-preset
skills.description: Create or update a Sumsub cross-check preset (POI↔POA name/address comparison rules) via POST/PATCH /resources/api/agent/crossCheckPresets. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to override cross-check defaults; Sumsub's default preset is tuned for best approval rate and should not be replaced casually.

skills.name: sumsub-create-workflow
skills.description: Create a Sumsub applicant workflow (verification routing or action workflow) via the public API: compact node/edge spec → draft → validate → publish, gated by live traffic (automatic when low, confirmed when high). Publishing changes live traffic — see the Danger section.

skills.name: sumsub-create-transaction
skills.description: Submit a transaction to Sumsub Transaction Monitoring (KYT). Compact spec → full KytTxnData payload → POST /resources/applicants/{id|-}/kyt/txns/-/data (auto-routed for existing vs non-existing applicants). Covers finance, travelRule, and userPlatformEvent variants.

skills.name: sumsub-integrate-websdk
skills.description: End-to-end Sumsub WebSDK integration for a web app. Covers level setup, server-signed access-token endpoint, snsWebSdk init (vanilla + React), client lifecycle events, webhook signature verification (including ngrok-based local testing), server-side status reads, sandbox testing, and go-live checklist.

skills.name: sumsub-integrate-msdk
skills.description: Add Sumsub identity verification (KYC) to your native iOS or Android app. Detects the platform, then walks you from installing the Mobile SDK (iOS: Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods; Android: Gradle + the Sumsub Maven repo) through permissions to a ready-to-run integration file — token refresh, lifecycle callbacks, and the launch point (iOS: UIKit or SwiftUI; Android: Activity, Fragment, or Compose) included, with your approval at each step. Native iOS & Android only.

skills.name: sumsub-theme-msdk
skills.description: Theme the Sumsub Mobile SDK to match a mobile app's design system. Scans the app's colors, fonts, corner radii and light/dark handling, derives a full palette, and generates a SumsubTheme class wired at the launch site. iOS (Swift/SNSTheme subclass) and Android (Kotlin/SNSTheme DSL).

skills.name: sumsub-integrate-id-connect
skills.description: End-to-end Sumsub ID Connect (OIDC) integration. Covers Dashboard config, the @sumsub/id-connect frontend button/modal, backend authorization-code exchange at /resources/snsId/api/connect/token, share-token minting at /resources/accessTokens/sumsubIdShareToken, the partner-consent shareLink fallback, and applicant materialisation via /resources/api/reusableIdentity/reuse.

skills.name: sumsub-api-generic
skills.description: Fallback catch-all for Sumsub API tasks not covered by a more specific skill. Searches the bundled OpenAPI schema, builds the payload, signs with App Token, and validates.

skills.name: sumsub-check-permissions
skills.description: Fetch the current tenant's allowed entitlements (BackgroundCheckTarget list). Returns JSON `{"allowedChecks": {key: label}}` — a map whose keys are the enabled entitlement keys. Called by create-* skills before building a payload to gate entitlement-required features.

skills.name: sumsub-check-skills-version
skills.description: Check whether the installed Sumsub agent-skills package is up to date. Fetches the canonical version from https://api.sumsub.com/llms.txt and compares it to the locally installed version: warns on a patch-level drift, and recommends re-running `npx skills add sumsub/agent-skills --all` on a minor/major drift.

skills.name: sumsub-analyze-regulation
skills.description: Analyze a regulation document (PDF or text) and produce a Sumsub configuration plan — mapping regulatory requirements to Sumsub entities (levels, questionnaires, PoA presets, TM rules, workflows). Entry point before invoking create-level, create-questionnaire, create-poa-preset, create-workflow, and other skills.

skills.name: sumsub-integrate-dint-standalone
skills.description: Add Sumsub Device Intelligence (the Fisherman JS module) to your own web pages where there is NO Sumsub verification widget — login, signup, password reset, 2FA, checkout, or any high-value action you want fraud-screened. TRIGGER when the user asks to "add device intelligence to login / signup", "fingerprint the device on a custom page", "use Fisherman standalone / self-hosted", "ongoing monitoring of platform events", "pre-KYC device check", "detect multi-accounting at signup", or "send a financial transaction with the captured device". Covers the whole loop — behavior access token, @sumsub/fisherman init + fingerprint, confirming the event (platform event / financial transaction / create-applicant), reading results, sandbox, go-live. SKIP when the page already embeds the Sumsub WebSDK — Device Intelligence rides along inside it, use `sumsub-integrate-dint-websdk`.

skills.name: sumsub-integrate-dint-websdk
skills.description: Add Sumsub Device Intelligence (the Fisherman module) to a web project that already verifies users with the Sumsub WebSDK. TRIGGER when the user asks to "add device intelligence", "enable device capture / fingerprinting in the WebSDK", "turn on Fisherman", "detect device fraud / multi-accounting in the verification flow", or asks how device risk labels get onto an applicant verified through the WebSDK. Covers the whole loop — enabling Capture devices on the level, the automatic in-SDK Fisherman lifecycle, the advanced self-rendered wiring, reading device signals (Devices tab, Device Check, risk labels, webhooks), sandbox testing, go-live checklist. SKIP for device intelligence on pages with NO WebSDK widget (login / signup / checkout) — use `sumsub-integrate-dint-standalone`; SKIP for the base WebSDK embed itself — use `sumsub-integrate-websdk`.

skills.name: sumsub-create-kyt-rules
skills.description: Create or modify KYT transaction monitoring scoring rules via POST /resources/api/agent/tm/rules. Translates user-described conditions (amount thresholds, country lists, aggregations, scheduled applicant checks) into KytTxnRule payloads and POSTs them one at a time. The endpoint validates conditionEl and creates the rule in one call — HTTP 200 returns KytTxnRuleView on success, HTTP 400 returns an error message on failure. Rules start in testMode (dryRun) and must be activated in the dashboard.

skills.name: sumsub-manage-webhooks
skills.description: Manage Sumsub clientWebhooks (event subscriptions) via /resources/clientWebhooks: list (oldest 50), GET /{id} for one, POST to create, and PATCH to update. Sandbox only — production webhooks must be created by a human directly in the dashboard. Delete and per-webhook delivery stats are dashboard-only and not covered by this skill.

skills.name: sumsub-supported-id-documents
skills.description: Read and edit Sumsub supported identity documents. READ the built-in catalogue (GET /resources/api/agent/supportedDocs/documentsByCountries) with a local filter script that returns only the relevant slice. EDIT a client's overrides via read-modify-write: a builder script merges the changed (country, docType) fields into the client's current map locally, then the full map goes to the replace-all PUT /resources/api/agent/globalSettings/idDocSettings/countryMappings (explicit confirmation required); removal / restore-to-default sends the same PUT minus the entry.

skills.name: sumsub-manage-applicant-tags
skills.description: Add, replace, or remove tags on a Sumsub applicant profile via the public API — POST /resources/applicants/{applicantId}/tags/add (additive), POST .../tags (overwrite full set), DELETE .../tags (remove), read-back via GET .../one. TRIGGER when the user asks to tag / untag an applicant, add / remove / clear applicant tags, label an applicant profile, or replace an applicant's tag set. SKIP for transaction tags, tag definitions with scoring weights, or applicant risk assessment (sumsub-create-kyt-rules), for automated tagging inside workflows (sumsub-create-workflow), and for tag-change webhook subscriptions (sumsub-manage-webhooks).

skills.name: sumsub-conformance
skills.description: Check whether a tenant's DEPLOYED Sumsub config actually satisfies a regulation/policy document. Ingests the regulation (renders PDF pages for visual reading), resolves the live config graph (level + questionnaires-with-scores + presets + auto-found workflow + entitlements), and traces each requirement to where it is collected, scored, and ENFORCED — bucketing findings MISSING / SCORING-MISMATCH / COLLECTED-NOT-ENFORCED / NOT-CONFIG-REPRESENTABLE / CONFORMANT. Surfaces 'collected-but-not-enforced' gaps no other skill sees. Advisory, human-signed; deterministic spine + LLM judgment kept separate. Sandbox only.

skills.name: sumsub-create-aml-resolution-rules
skills.description: Create, edit, reorder, delete, and publish Sumsub AML Resolution Rules (AML Resolution Rule Chain) that auto-review AML screening hits. Defaults to draft.

skills.name: sumsub-integrate-travel-rule
skills.description: End-to-end Sumsub Travel Rule integration recipe — pick the flow (before settlement / after settlement / answering), identify the counterparty VASP, submit the transfer, read the exchange status, finalise or cancel, and answer incoming requests with the two ordered responses. Also covers the unhosted-wallet path when no VASP is attributed (POST /resources/tr/sdk/init, ownership checks, manual verification) and finding existing transactions via GET /resources/kyt/txns/query/- including the deduplication ladder before after-settlement exchanges.

skills.name: sumsub-manage-wallet-address-book
skills.description: Register the crypto wallet addresses an organisation controls so Travel Rule ownership resolves without a human. Bulk import via POST /resources/kyt/walletAddress/import (max 10000 per call), or bind one address to an applicant via POST /resources/api/applicants/{applicantId}/payments.

skills.name: sumsub-resolve-currency
skills.description: Resolve and validate Sumsub transaction currency fields — currencyCode, currencyType, cryptoParams.cryptoChain and the amountInDefaultCurrency pair. Reads GET /resources/kyt/currency?type=crypto|fiat and resolves (symbol, chain, contract) to exactly one asset, normalising chain aliases and refusing ambiguous input instead of guessing.
